entries.text: A TPC-H or TPC-DS result at a scale factor outside the standard list is no longer refused by the published-results validator. It is accepted, shown with the nonstandard-scale warning and left out of ranking, as `benchbox submit` already reported locally. This holds whether the result is stamped unofficial_nonstandard, unofficial_subscale or official, or carries no compliance class, and for every benchmark: results at an unlisted scale are now excluded from ranking there as well.
